runtime_choices.kernel_backend: tilelang: every kernel serving launches is TileLang except NCCL and a few rare-path ATen copies (experiments/2026-10-24-tilelang-completion): TileLang 0.1.15 (0001-0003 and r6u's 0004: prepare and freeze), DeepSeek's TileKernels 2.0.0 (patches/tile_kernels 0001) and sparknet's TileLang collectives, with the sampling, verification, drafting, runner-input, generation-control, logprob, vision-tower and CED kernels ported from Triton, torch and B12X; no B12X preparation runs and the runner warm-up compiles no Triton. B12X keeps the checkpoint loader; three load-time Triton kernels pack the BF16 LM head
runtime_choices.speculative: DSpark, 5 tokens (the drafter's trained block), draft TP 4 (TP 3 on the triangle), greedy drafting with block verification; adaptive verification budgets each step's drafts by a rule of the inputs: the argmax over k of expected tokens / (1 + 0.035 x rows) (adaptive_verification_row_cost 0.035, vLLM 0184). Nothing is timed at boot: the cost profile, the per-build pinned curves and the cost scale are gone, so every build and boot drafts the same way. Dead verification rows as before.
runtime_choices.cudagraph: FULL_AND_PIECEWISE, capture sizes 1-96 on the ring (16 streams at 1 + 5 rows); 1-48 on the triangle (8 streams)
runtime_choices.max_num_batched_tokens: 16384 on the ring (from this release: with the CED skip, prefill +5.4-6.3% over 8,192; the decode steps beside a long prompt about twice as long), 4096 on the triangle
runtime_choices.flashinfer_autotune: disabled (--no-enable-flashinfer-autotune): without it the autotuner's dummy runs start; no FlashInfer kernel serves
runtime_choices.engram_projection: sharded across ranks (projection_tp, padded to 25632 rows by vLLM patch 0001)
runtime_choices.engram_rows: one process-wide native reader thread (no Python, no GIL, no CUDA calls) reads both tables' rows in layer order; since r6o it reads the rows of the tokens the host already knows before the step starts (vLLM 0148); a disk shard is whole hash columns, every tp-th (vLLM 0153, 0154): heads 0-7 hash 2-grams, 8-15 3-grams and 16-23 4-grams, so each rank reads columns of every order, and the ranks' columns are joined by an all-gather in column order instead of summed; in the forward a one-thread TileLang kernel waits for each table's step, bounded by SPARK_DS41F_ENGRAM_ROWS_TIMEOUT_MS (10 s) and stopped at once by a failed read, then the TileLang gather loads only this rank's columns (vLLM 0145, 0154)
runtime_choices.compile_cache: /cache/spark-ds41f/jit/vllm (the cache moved from /cache/kkref on 2026-10-23, which stays a link for the frozen recipes)
runtime_choices.multimodal: vision tower loaded (no --language-model-only), up to 4 images per request; --mm-processor-cache-gb 0 (vLLM's default 4 GiB host cache would come out of dgx1's guard margin)
runtime_choices.host_sysctl: vm.watermark_boost_factor=0 on every node (/etc/sysctl.d/90-watermark-boost.conf): a watermark boost hides up to 0.87 GiB from MemAvailable, which the memory guards read
runtime_choices.l2_prefetch: on: side-stream L2 prefetch of the next decode projections, now TileLang kernels (VLLM_L2_PREFETCH_KERNELS=tilelang; vLLM 0119 refuses to run without them); the TileLang scale words ride with each projection's weight (vLLM 0044)
runtime_choices.nccl: 2.30.7 rebuilt with patches/nccl (NVIDIA/nccl#2393 IB send-path fence and the four-node ring patches) in place of the base image's wheel
runtime_choices.chat_template_defaults: none: thinking is the default when a request names neither key, so a client's enable_thinking=false is honored
runtime_choices.prefill: sequence-parallel once a forward's reduce-scatter exceeds the one-shot RoCE all-reduce (205 tokens; vLLM patches 0014-0018, no setting): per-layer all-reduces become reduce-scatters, row-wise work runs on a third of the rows, CED encoder layers only
runtime_choices.host: mutating torch custom ops read their argument schema once per call (vLLM patch 0019, vllm/env_override.py), not once per argument
runtime_choices.cutlass_dsl: 4.7.1 for every consumer (vLLM, quack-kernels, B12X via patch 0002, FlashInfer, cuDNN frontend)
runtime_choices.jit_caches: driver PTX JIT cache (CUDA_CACHE_PATH, 4 GiB limit), the TileLang cache and the Triton cache (the head's load-time packing) on the /cache mount; the B12X, CuTe DSL, FlashInfer and Inductor cache settings are gone with the kernels they configured
runtime_choices.jit_warmup: kernel preparation (vLLM 0156-0172, TileLang 0004): before memory profiling each rank compiles every declared TileLang call (247 at TP4) in one pool and runs TileKernels' warm calls, then freezes TileLang's cache: a kernel not prepared fails by name on every rank. Profiling, warm-up, capture and serving compile nothing. Warm: 11.0 s a rank; a new image's first boot compiles its new kernels once (24.4 s). The JIT monitor is off (--jit-monitor-mode off): under TileLang it had nothing left to report, and it cost 0.4% at eight streams
runtime_choices.display_carveout: off on the ring (SPARK_DS41F_DISPLAY_CARVEOUT_WEIGHTS=0: in the carve-out the head lost its L2 reuse); on for the triangle, whose KV budget needs it
runtime_choices.indexer_split: always under sequence-parallel prefill (patch 0025; SPARK_DS41F_DS41_INDEXER_SPLIT_CHECK=1 validates it against the full-row indexer)
runtime_choices.topk_ties: lowest logical position (B12X 0003); indexer selections repeat exactly (B12X backend)
runtime_choices.dense_gemm_stage_release: async-proxy fence before each TMA-refilled stage release (B12X 0004) (B12X backend)
runtime_choices.prefill_stage_release: async-proxy fence before each TMA-refilled stage release in the BF16 and mHC prefill projections and contiguous attention (B12X 0005) (B12X backend)
runtime_choices.host_memory: 64 KiB pages; memory-saver DKMS 0.2.0, UVM leaf-table packing enabled; THP never, vm.min_free_kbytes=45166, /swap-64k.img
runtime_choices.vocabulary_head: exact 12-bit packed BF16 (VLLM_DS41_PACKED_BF16_LM_HEAD=1; B12X 0012, vLLM 0028): a 4-bit exponent window code plus a per-row list of out-of-window values, bit-identical to the BF16 weights; logits in FP32 (VLLM_DS41_HEAD_DTYPE=float32, the reference's head_dtype)
runtime_choices.collective_policy: sparknet's one-shot RoCE all-reduce up to 2 MiB (SPARKNET_ROCE_ALLREDUCE_DISPATCH_MAX_BYTES=2097152) and all-gather over the triangle (oneshot-direct); sequence-parallel reduce-scatters exchange unreduced chunks through NCCL send/recv and add them in rank order; sparknet 0.5.0 (timeout-stop's design: TileLang kernels only, every wait timed by the GPU clock (SPARKNET_ROCE_TIMEOUT_MS=10000) and a timed-out wait records the peer, lane and sequence and traps; since 0.5.0 a data phase of one 16-byte pack a thread over up to 64 blocks, one poller after the doorbell, and the all-gather in one round trip); the TP group's broadcast (DSpark's per-step confidences) runs on the one-shot all-gather, so serving never uses the PyTorch NCCL process group (vLLM 0185); no fallback to other backends (vLLM 0142); the proxy thread on a big core (SPARKNET_ROCE_PROXY_CPU=big)
runtime_choices.profiling_context: the fabricated context of startup profiling and dummy runs takes its own blocks per KV cache group and request (vLLM 0039), so no group reads another group's records
runtime_choices.four_node_transports: B12X's RoCEnante transports and NCCL 0002-0004 remain in the image; TileLang configurations use sparknet's ring4 transport at TP4
runtime_choices.decode_tiles: block-32 FP8 decode rows on 16-, 32- or 64-row tiles by row count, and split-K tiles up to 128 rows for 16-stream steps (D1), TileLang's unspecialized pipeline; prefill rasterizes weights larger than L2 in panels (vLLM 0043)
runtime_choices.batch_invariance: temperature-0 outputs do not depend on the batch: the reduce-scatter and all-reduces past the one-shot limit add every rank's partial in FP32 in rank order with one rounding, the compressor projection runs one TileLang arithmetic at every row count, prefill chunks align (threshold 16288 = budget 16384 - 16 x (1 + 5) decode rows on the ring; 4048 on the triangle), and a mixed step runs sparse MLA per request, so decode rows keep the decode plan beside a prefill
runtime_choices.reference_precision: DeepSeek's reference inference/model.py term for term where r6d rounded early: FP32 logits; the mHC stream projection in FP32, each FP32 weight split into three exact TF32 parts; the shared expert's SwiGLU in FP32 with one rounding; MoE partials rounded once per rank; WO-A's input through act_quant (E4M3, UE8M0 per 32) as the reference's 2026-10-12 revision does for both V4.1 Flash checkpoints, then the BF16 einsum (vLLM 0177, 0179), with WO-B's input cast exactly as the reference's act_quant
runtime_choices.greedy_verification: an all-greedy verification step whose logits nothing reads (no logprobs, penalties, logit bias, bad words, thinking budget, grammar, top-k/p, min-p) reduces each rank's vocabulary shard to a (max, index) pair and applies rejection_sample's greedy rule (vLLM 0112-0114, VLLM_GREEDY_VERIFICATION): the same committed tokens without the FP32 logits all-gather
runtime_choices.moe_shared_fold: the shared expert's output is added in the TileLang MoE combine with one rounding also when it runs on the aux stream (decode, up to 256 tokens): the combine waits for it (vLLM 0111, 0116)
runtime_choices.vocabulary_head_grid: token tiles vary fastest in the head kernel's grid, so a call past 64 rows reads each vocabulary block's packed weights once from DRAM (vLLM 0117)
runtime_choices.wo_projection: TileLang: the sparse MLA kernels store WO-A's input (vLLM 0179: the inverse RoPE, then the reference's act_quant quantize-dequantize, once per row in their output store); WO-A is a W8A16 GEMM on those BF16 values, split-K tiles by row bucket up to 128 rows and in-kernel tiles past that; its last kernel rounds to BF16 and applies the reference's per-token cast, so WO-B (the reference's MXFP8 linear) reads E4M3 and UE8M0 scales straight from it; sequence-parallel steps project through the rank-order exchange
runtime_choices.dspark_context_kv: TileLang block-32 projection with the reference's activation cast (vLLM 0131)
runtime_choices.sparse_mla_fold: every route (split, decode, extend) folds a segment as fma(l, b, L * a), so a prompt prefilled inside a sequence-parallel forward of other prompts rounds as it does alone (vLLM 0132; before, the extend route's one-segment fold was contracted by the compiler)
runtime_choices.startup_rendezvous: ranks meet before memory profiling on liveness, not a deadline: each rank's heartbeat (phase, kernels prepared) keeps the others waiting while it prepares (VLLM_STARTUP_RENDEZVOUS_TIMEOUT_MS is gone); profiling and warm-up name a stopped one-shot collective, as serving steps do (forum 384438#24)
runtime_choices.draft_budget: the draft-budget selection runs eagerly with its kernels loaded at startup (vLLM 0144); since r6x the budget is a fixed linear step cost (vLLM 0184), and the eager shapes past the capture limit run once at startup, untimed
runtime_choices.nan_contracts: non-finite contracts for ten kernel families (vLLM 0134-0136, tests); the shared SwiGLU clamps (0137), the Engram gate floor (0138) and TileKernels' routed SwiGLU clamp (patches/tile_kernels 0001) keep a NaN, bit-identical on finite inputs
runtime_choices.engram_prefill: under prefill sequence parallelism each rank sends every other rank only that rank's real rows of its Engram wkv column block (vLLM 0150, 0152), and the TileLang gate reads the received blocks in place (engram_gate_blocked, bit-identical to the packed gate)
runtime_choices.checkpoint_copies: checkpoint tensors are copied to the GPU through anonymous memory, never pinned (vLLM 0147): a large host-to-device copy from untouched, unaligned file-mapped pages hangs on R580 with 64 KiB pages
runtime_choices.engram_debug_timeline: off (SPARK_DS41F_ENGRAM_TIMELINE, vLLM 0151; since r6s it records planning time too)
runtime_choices.sampling_defaults: DeepSeek's recommendation for V4.1 Flash 1017: temperature 1.0, top_p 1.0 for requests that set none (recipe generation_defaults, rendered as --override-generation-config); benchmarks and gates set their own
runtime_choices.chat_encoding: DeepSeek's 2026-10-16 encoding (vLLM 0178): a user message of only tool results continues the turn, so its reasoning is kept; tool-result images follow their calls' order; image placeholder tokens in text are refused; control-token spellings written in request text (messages, text parts, reasoning, tool results, tool-call arguments, tool definitions) stay plain text, so only the template's own markup becomes control tokens, as DeepSeek's encoder does (vLLM 0227, #449, from Acermax)
runtime_choices.model_mount: the Hugging Face hub cache mounted whole at /hub (1017's snapshot links into the hub's shared blob store), served from /hub/<snapshot>
runtime_choices.row_exchange: Engram's sequence-parallel row all-to-all (vLLM 0150) at four ranks sends the neighbours their blocks and each half of the opposite rank's block through one neighbour, forwarded in a second group (vLLM 0180): a switchless ring has no cable between ranks two apart. The triangle exchanges directly.
runtime_choices.routed_swiglu: TileLang moe_swiglu_cast (vLLM 0181) in place of TileKernels' swiglu_forward_and_per_token_cast: the clamp, SwiGLU, route weight and MXFP8 cast over the live tiles of the dispatch layout only, element for element TileKernels' arithmetic (bytes and scales identical)
runtime_choices.expert_scale_codes: the routed experts' UE8M0 weight scales as a per-row base exponent and 4-bit deltas (vLLM 0182-0183), expanded in the grouped GEMM's stage: exact (rows span at most 8 exponents), half the scale bytes, about 2.1 GiB a rank freed at TP4 (2.7 GiB at TP3); the KV pool is unchanged
runtime_choices.late_admission: the async engine decides step N+1 when step N reaches decoder layer 30 (VLLM_LATE_ADMISSION_LAYER=30, vLLM 0222) instead of as N starts, so a request that arrives during N joins N+1 (TP3 screen: TTFT p50 -26% at four streams, -30% at eight); a step that continues a prompt chunk has its successor decided at once (vLLM 0226), so chunked prefill keeps async scheduling's lead
runtime_choices.sink_rejection: on by default for DeepSeek V4.1 (vLLM 0221, 0223; VLLM_SINK_REJECTION unset): the forward keeps the sink column (2455, threshold 85,000, in vllm.v1.sample.sink.SINK_CHANNELS), and a decoding request's next token is held as draft zero of the following step and rejected when it lands on the sink, so short prompts such as `Say hi.` and `Thanks!` no longer collapse; zero flags on ordinary text; the first token alone waits one decode step longer. Switchable (VLLM_SINK_REJECTION=0) so the checkpoint-specific code is marked for removal (owner, 2026-10-22); each rank's log line counts every step it executes, vllm:sink_* the flags in committed outputs (vLLM 0264, #489)
runtime_choices.names: container spark-ds41f, image repository spark-ds41f, labels local.spark-ds41f.*, sources under /opt/spark-ds41f, SPARK_DS41F_* variables (vLLM 0262), caches under /cache/spark-ds41f, boot memory service spark-ds41f-kernel-memory: the live names leave karmic-kraken, kkref and spark3
runtime_choices.malloc: glibc malloc pinned in every process (MALLOC_ARENA_MAX=2, MALLOC_MMAP_THRESHOLD_=1048576): the API server's per-thread arenas had grown +1.08 of +1.16 GiB over a soak at 1M (#439); pinned, +0.35 GiB; no measured cost (experiments/2026-10-23-next-release, A/B 2026-10-24)
runtime_choices.ced: the compressed-entry row selection's kernels in TileLang (vLLM 0229-0254, bit-identical, 2-31% faster per call) and its nonfinal row skip (0255; TP3 prefill +10.6-11.1% from 32K to 500K, outputs identical)
runtime_choices.block_verification_sampling: fresh random draws in each verification round (vLLM 0228, a backport of vllm-project/vllm#61161): temperature 0 unchanged, sampled text changes by design
runtime_choices.generation_controls: V4.1's tokenizer honours add_generation_prompt and continue_final_message (vLLM 0256), and the DeepSeek API's top-level `thinking` switch turns thinking on or off (0257, #447)
runtime_choices.prompt_tokens_details: on (--enable-prompt-tokens-details, #469): every response's usage reports its prompt-cache hits
runtime_choices.glp_steering: available, off unless configured (msuiche's #401, reworked: vLLM 0258, 0261, 0263, 0265): one TileLang projection a layer, 320 threads a row in one configuration for every batch, faster than the compiled torch projection at decode and level at long prefill; off, outputs and speed are spark-ds41f-1022's; on (a synthetic file), grid +2.4%, 16 streams -1.2%, prefill -1.9% (candidate 2's window)
runtime_choices.max_logprobs: at most 32 (the TileLang top-k ids kernel takes k up to 32; --max-logprobs above 32 or -1 is refused at startup, an accepted compatibility change); the recipe runs vLLM's default of 20
runtime_choices.prompt_logprobs: a request's prompt logprobs go out with it under sink rejection (vLLM 0266; before, one such request killed EngineCore)
runtime_choices.logprob_token_ids: speculatively verified tokens carry their custom logprob ids (vLLM 0267; before, HTTP 500)
runtime_choices.token_ranks: selected-token ranks exclude the vocabulary padding: a selected -inf token ranks at most 129,280, not 131,072 (#504)
runtime_choices.vision_tower: TileLang, following DeepSeek's reference arithmetic (image outputs differ from B12X's tower); on 2,283 public benchmark items it scores as B12X's does (experiments/2026-10-25-vision-eval)

evidence.summary: On the ring at 1M, on 1017. Candidate 6's window (run candidate-6-tp4, 2026-10-25 13:43-14:43 CET) on its own image: release tests 5,730 passed, 160 skipped, 0 failed; temperature-0 outputs identical to spark-ds41f-1022's (3eab5112 / db25fde3, c9cf9dbe / c6bb4f4e); generation controls, logprob ids and prompt logprobs pass; image digest the overlay's; 247 TileLang calls prepared in 11 s a rank, API ready in 87 s, no B12X preparation or compiles. Release comparison (run candidate-6-release-tp4, one session, 14:46-18:20 CET, candidate 6 / spark-ds41f-1022 / candidate 6 again, verdicts against the repeat): greedy 256/256 identical, teacher-forced KL 0; decode grid -2.38% (better, repeat +1.14%); prefill +12.80% / +13.85% / +13.73% / +12.89% / +11.81% at 32K / 131K / 262K / 524K / 1M (better); c16 +0.12%, c8 +0.88%, Poisson +0.01%, one stream +2.11% (same; engine steps a second +1.95%, better); sampled c16 +0.40%, c8 +0.70%, c1 +2.65% (same). Vision on 2,283 public benchmark items scores the same as spark-ds41f-1022 (+0.43 points for 1022, interval [-0.14, +1.02]). Candidate 6's first arm is the suite reference.
